example.title: Young Building (John Margolies Roadside America photos)

brief: Two-storey Romanesque Revival red-brick front with a slate mansard-like front roof slope: three broad round-arched upper windows with fanlights, diapered brick panels and a corbelled cornice. The ground floor has a deep round-arched central entry flanked by two wide multi-pane display windows with transoms and dark awnings; a small projecting board sign hangs by the arch. Brick neighbours on both sides.

storefronts.sign: VOSS & LINDQVIST - ATTORNEYS AT LAW - 2ND FLOOR
